_about: The k>=2 coding frame for the M02 redo L1 arm, one row per (surface, group). k is the LIST of voting models, not the count, so the roster is a property of this file rather than of whoever ran the loop.
_rulings: [5170] no shape filter; [5176] k>=2 (RH); [5179] group language, k-roster = every checkpoint with data, population = 41 status-filtered groups, six roles.
